sources.title: Yazdani: Riccati manuscript
sources.note: Provisional manuscript; distinguish constant fixed points from instantaneous roots and WKB approximations.

sources.title: Yazdani: helical geometry manuscript
sources.note: Helical phase theta=v+2*pi*k*u and periodic closure motivate representation. No market mechanism or physical claim is imported as established.

sources.title: Gu and Dao: Mamba
sources.note: Input-dependent selection is separable from its discretisation and scan implementation. No Mamba cell is used in this prototype.

sources.title: Muca Cirone et al.: theoretical foundations of selective SSMs
sources.coverage: Introduction and theoretical framing inspected; v4 2025-01-06
sources.note: Connects selectivity to rough paths/signatures; motivates cross-channel interaction ablations. No finance performance implication.

sources.title: Kidger et al.: neural controlled differential equations
sources.note: Continuous-time memory driven by observations; online interpolation must use available observations only.

sources.title: Cariñena and de Lucas: integrability through Riccati equations
sources.coverage: Theory framing inspected; v3; J Nonlinear Math Phys 2011
sources.note: Lie-system reductions and transformation conditions; general Riccati equations are not solved by algebraic roots alone.

sources.title: Schreiber and Schmitz: surrogate time series
sources.coverage: Abstract and metadata only; Physica D 2000
sources.note: Test nonlinear explanations against specified stochastic nulls. Rejection of one null is not proof of deterministic chaos.

sources.title: Bacry et al.: Hawkes processes in finance
sources.coverage: Definitions and stability section inspected; v2
sources.note: Event excitation and microstructure. For the standard nonnegative linear Hawkes model, integrated-kernel spectral radius below one is the stationary stability condition.

sources.title: Borio: financial cycle and macroeconomics
sources.note: Prioritise credit, leverage and liquidity. Full paper and empirical calibration remain queued.

sources.title: Shiller: Narrative Economics
sources.coverage: First 6 PDF pages inspected; January 2017 working paper
sources.note: Narrative diffusion is a research mechanism; reverse causality and measurement remain material.

sources.title: Alevy, Haigh and List: information cascades experiment
sources.coverage: Abstract and metadata inspected; WP 2006; published J Finance 2007
sources.note: Experimental market professionals and students differ. Avoid assuming one universal retail psychology.

sources.title: ALFRED vintage data documentation
sources.note: Retrieve releases available at past dates; release/vintage dates require timestamp precision for intraday research.

sources.title: Li et al.: Fourier Neural Operator
sources.note: Operator learning across PDE families; no claim that market dynamics obey a known PDE.

sources.title: Brunton et al.: Modern Koopman Theory
sources.note: Nonlinear dynamics can be represented by a linear operator on observables; finite useful closures are difficult.

sources.title: Smith et al.: S5
sources.note: Multi-input multi-output state space reference and computational baseline.

sources.title: Bailey et al.: Probability of Backtest Overfitting
sources.coverage: First 8 PDF pages inspected; February 2015 version
sources.note: Multiple strategy trials require selection-bias diagnostics; CSCV/PBO does not replace a chronological untouched evaluation.

sources.title: Bailey and López de Prado: Deflated Sharpe Ratio
sources.coverage: First 8 PDF pages inspected; July 2014 version
sources.note: Accounts for multiple selection and non-normality under its assumptions; dependence and trial correlation must also be assessed.

sources.title: Vast.ai Python SDK quickstart
sources.note: Create returns new_contract; storage starts at creation. Poll with deadlines, export results, destroy and confirm. Stopping alone is insufficient for full cleanup.

sources.title: Datadog OpenTelemetry Collector setup
sources.note: Collector/OTLP integration supported. Pin chosen collector version and verify telemetry ingestion; documentation is not evidence of deployed monitoring.

sources.title: Elastic Docker Compose installation
sources.note: Security/password setup and localhost port binding; version pin, persistent volume and retention validation remain deployment prerequisites.

sources.title: ATO tax invoices
sources.note: Required supplier/ABN/date/items/GST fields; buyer identity or ABN at AUD 1000 or more; applicable request timing.

sources.title: ATO GST credits
sources.note: Registration, business use, GST in purchase and evidence conditions; valid tax invoice normally needed above AUD 82.50.

sources.title: ATO business deductions
sources.note: Business purpose and records are required; exclude private portions and avoid deducting a GST amount already claimable as a credit.

sources.title: Stripe webhook documentation
sources.coverage: Official event behaviour and verification sections inspected 2026-10-27
sources.note: Verify raw-body signatures with official library, handle duplicate events, retries and unordered delivery.

sources.title: Stripe idempotent requests
sources.note: Persist local operation IDs; API v1 idempotency retention does not provide indefinite deduplication.

sources.title: ANZ PayTo
sources.note: Merchant creates agreement; account holder authorises it through banking channel. Not evidence of a universal personal-account payment API.

sources.title: Kahneman and Tversky: Prospect Theory
sources.coverage: Primary-source search extract; full methods queued
sources.note: Reference dependence and choice under risk inform hypotheses; trader behaviour must be measured rather than presumed.

sources.title: Brock and Hommes: heterogeneous beliefs and routes to chaos
sources.coverage: Primary paper discovered; full read queued
sources.note: Heterogeneous expectations provide a simulation candidate, not evidence that any observed market is deterministic chaos.

sources.title: Gu et al.: S4
sources.note: Structured long-memory baseline. Market evaluation remains separate from sequence benchmarks.

sources.title: Orvieto et al.: Linear Recurrent Unit
sources.note: Strong direct recurrence reference for matched-compute comparison; full methods reproduction queued.

sources.title: Gu, Kelly and Xiu: empirical asset pricing via ML
sources.note: Nonlinear predictor interactions are existing financial research; replicate data and validation design before importing reported results.
